description.zh:
WAF实例的接入类型。取值：

- **share**（默认）：表示CNAME接入。
- **hybrid\_cloud_cname** ：表示混合云反向代理接入。
description.en:
The access type of the WAF instance. Valid values:

- **share** (default): CNAME access.
- **hybrid\_cloud_cname**: hybrid cloud reverse proxy access.
The domain name that has been connected to WAF.

description.zh:
WAF实例的ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)，查看当前WAF实例的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the WAF instance.
> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the WAF instance.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi delete-domain --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --domain www.aliyundoc.com --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --access-type share --domain-id www.aliyundoc.com-waf --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun waf-openapi DeleteDomain --region cn-hangzhou --DomainId 'www.aliyundoc.com-waf' --InstanceId waf_cdnsdf30000 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Domain 'www.aliyundoc.com' --AccessType share
